overview.title: Fix User Editing Form - Email and Password Fields Not Editable
overview.description: The user editing modal has incorrect readonly field behavior. The email and password fields appear as readonly (purple background) when they should be editable, while only the username field should be readonly for security reasons (as per v3.8.1).
overview.current_issue: Based on screenshot analysis: - Имя пользователя (User Name) field: readonly (should be editable) - Email field: readonly (should be editable) - Логин (Username) field: editable (should be readonly for security) - Пароль (Password) field: readonly (should be editable)
overview.expected_behavior: - User Name field: editable - Email field: editable - Username field: readonly (for security - prevent accidental login credential changes) - Password field: editable (with optional behavior during editing)

root_cause_analysis.hypothesis: The UserModal component has incorrect readonly prop assignments or there's a logic error in how the readonly state is determined. The code shows only username should be readonly, but the UI shows the opposite behavior.
